name: session.location.autocomplete
title: Profile: session.location.autocomplete
description: Canonical MCP pattern for searching places and addresses from partial text.
text:
# Session location autocomplete

TL;DR:
- Use this profile when the user is typing a place or address and needs structured suggestions.
- Supply free-form text and a target language code.
- The result is a ranked array of normalized location suggestions.
whenToUse: The user is typing a city, municipality, street, or address fragment.
You need structured coordinates or a normalized address before another tool call.
recommended: Use the user's interface or response language for lang.
Prefer address as the display label when showing suggestions.
Prefer the highest-confidence result when the user wants one best guess.
avoid: Do not use this profile for exact database lookup by stable location id.
Do not expect a non-empty result for text shorter than 3 characters.
exampleInterpretation: Treat the response as ranked suggestions, not a guaranteed exact match.
Use address as the primary human-readable label.
Reuse lat and lon for later geo-aware listing queries.
